key_insight: Self-building laboratories extend experimental automation by designing, configuring, and operating lab setups from high-level scientific goals.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce manual integration and programming when adapting automated laboratories to new experiments.
method: Start from available infrastructure, ranging from an empty room to an existing self-driving laboratory.
Build missing capabilities: lab layouts, digital twins, robot skills, and experimental workflows.
Coordinate experimental execution across single-workstation and multi-robot setups.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations across different robots and setups, including multi-robot laboratories, and end-to-end validation through real-world quantum-dot synthesis.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify setup effort, reliability, or safety performance, leaving deployment robustness unclear.
